dedupe_keys.name: rethinking power sector reform in the developing world dataset

description: Rethinking Power Sector Reform in the Developing World Dataset is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The Rethinking Power Sector Reform in the Developing World study is based on global data as well as 17 deep dive case studies that included data on 28 utilities, 17 regulators and national power sectors. Coverage: 14 countries. It has 6 files in XLS. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
